import sys, json; sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from kh import *
D=load(); d5=np.load('my5_feats_clean.npz')
Zp,yp=D['Zp'],D['yp']
Zmine=np.concatenate([D['Zm'],D['Z3'],D['Z4'],d5['Z']]); ymine=np.concatenate([D['ym'],D['y3'],D['y4'],d5['y']])
mu,sd,nbar=D['mu'],D['sd'],np.load('kernel_v3.npz')['nbar']
NC=3072-1496
sel=np.sort(np.random.default_rng(7).permutation(len(Zmine))[:NC])
C=np.concatenate([Zp,Zmine[sel]])
Zt=np.concatenate([Zp,Zmine]); yt=np.concatenate([yp,ymine]); wt=np.concatenate([np.ones(1496),np.full(len(Zmine),0.4)])
lam=0.005
Phi=gelu(Zt@C.T/768); A,b0=fit(Phi,yt,wt,lam)
F=Phi@A+b0
print(C.shape, np.abs(A).max(), 'train acc all', (F.argmax(1)==yt).mean(), 'prac', (F[:1496].argmax(1)==yp).mean(), 'mine', (F[1496:].argmax(1)==ymine).mean())
rng=np.random.default_rng(0); Fn=gelu((Zt[:500]+rng.normal(0,1e-3,(500,768)))@C.T/768)@A+b0; print('noise sens', np.abs(Fn-F[:500]).max())
np.savez('kernel_v5.npz',mu=mu,sd=sd,C=C,sel=sel,Zt=Zt,yt=yt,wt=wt,lam=lam,A=A,b0=b0,F=F,nbar=nbar)
U=np.load('U_v2.npy'); S=100
p='bert.encoder.layer.11.'
W1=(C/sd/768); b1=-(W1@mu)
W2=S*U@A.T; b2=U@(S*b0-U.T@nbar)
save_edit(p+'intermediate.dense.weight',W1.astype(np.float32))
save_edit(p+'intermediate.dense.bias',b1.astype(np.float32))
save_edit(p+'output.dense.weight',W2.astype(np.float32))
save_edit(p+'output.dense.bias',b2.astype(np.float32))
n=Zt*sd+mu
x=n+(S*F-(U.T@nbar))@U.T
xm=x-x.mean(1,keepdims=True); ln=xm/np.sqrt((xm**2).mean(1,keepdims=True)+1e-12)
logits=10*np.tanh(0.05*ln@U)
print('expected acc', (logits.argmax(1)==yt).mean())
np.save('v5_expected_logits.npy',logits)
